purpose: Quality-aware routing evaluation. Transport smoke prompts are explicitly non-authoritative for quality_score.

items.prompt: Compare two release strategies for a local audio runtime and identify the safer one under rollback constraints.
Prioritize three engineering tasks when one blocks correctness, one improves latency, and one only improves formatting. Explain the ordering.
A provider returns intermittent 429, occasional 503, and one EMPTY response. Separate the causal classes and propose bounded recovery without retry storms.
A shared global settings object is mutated around every provider request. Analyze the concurrency hazard and propose a design that preserves settings safety while allowing parallel calls.
Write a Python function that computes exponential cooldown capped at 900 seconds and honors a larger Retry-After up to 3600 seconds.
Write a pure Python function that returns a deterministic semantic cache key from task hash, context revision, capability, policy revision, and dependency revision.
Review code that increments concurrency after every success and never decreases it after 429. Identify the defect and specify the minimal safe correction.
Review a cache implementation keyed only by prompt text. Identify stale-result and cross-policy reuse risks and specify required key dimensions.
